definitions.gloss: going to work; coming to the office
definitions.explanation: The act of going to one's workplace, typically an office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧9⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出社|しゅっしゃ}する。
examples.english: I go to work at 9 o'clock every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出社|しゅっしゃ}せずに⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I'll work from home today instead of going to the office.

examples.japanese: {出社|しゅっしゃ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The time I go to work has become earlier.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{出|しゅつ} (to go out) + {社|しゃ} (company)

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧:
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}: going to work/office
- ⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧: leaving work or resigning from a company

REGISTER:
Neutral. Standard workplace vocabulary.

MODERN USAGE:
With the rise of remote work, {出社|しゅっしゃ} is often contrasted with ⟦{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}→在宅勤務：06158_zaitakukinmu⟧ (working from home) or ⟦リモートワーク→リモートワーク：06095_rimootowaaku⟧ (remote work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}する: to go to work
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: arrival time at work
- {出社|しゅっしゃ}⟦{日|び}→日：12732_nichi⟧: days in the office
- ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧{出社|しゅっしゃ}: how many days a week in the office
